methods.SparseTrack: Pseudo-depth estimation + hierarchical association in sparse subsets
methods.ByteTrack: Two-stage association (high/low confidence) with Kalman filter
methods.SORT: Single-stage IoU-based association with Kalman filter

key_concepts.pseudo_depth: Estimate relative depth from bbox bottom y-coordinate
key_concepts.sparse_decomposition: Split dense detection set into depth-based layers
key_concepts.hierarchical_association: Perform matching within each depth layer separately
key_concepts.occlusion_handling: Reduce matching ambiguity by separating occluding/occluded targets

comparison_axes: Occlusion handling (ID switches during occlusion events)
